verdict.rationale: Sardine documents async webhook events for business-verification updates, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence describes webhook signing or signature verification, nor event IDs, idempotency keys, or retry semantics for deduplicating repeated notifications. Merely having webhooks does not credit the authenticity and dedup capabilities this story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can verify alert-event authenticity and deduplicate retried notifications
